claim: Within the Kandyan kingdom, Muslim communities were not merely refugees from coastal pressure: merchants and intermediaries also performed useful economic and diplomatic functions, including transport, brokerage and connections toward Indian Ocean trading networks; Muslim physicians and other specialists also appear in the kingdom's social landscape.
bounded_by: Dewaraja is the principal specialist anchor in this run and emphasizes long-term accommodation. Individual offices, routes and episodes require independent corroboration before more granular promotion.
notes: Important correction to a pure-refuge narrative: displacement and functional integration can coexist.
